nodes.name: Boat Skills
nodes.description: Sailing racing competency assessment covering boat handling, starting, upwind and downwind performance, mark roundings and racing strategy.

nodes.name: Boat Handling
nodes.description: Controlling the boat smoothly and efficiently through manoeuvres, trim and changing conditions.

nodes.name: Tacking
nodes.description: Turning the bow through the wind with minimal loss of distance and speed.

nodes.name: Entry Timing
nodes.description: Starts the tack at the right moment relative to waves, pressure and nearby boats.

nodes.name: Rudder Control
nodes.description: Uses a progressive, appropriate rudder angle through the turn without stalling the blade.

nodes.name: Exit Speed Build
nodes.description: Exits on a slightly freed angle and rebuilds target speed before pointing.

nodes.name: Weight Transition
nodes.description: Moves body weight smoothly and on time to roll and then flatten the boat.

nodes.name: Gybing
nodes.description: Turning the stern through the wind with control in all wind strengths.

nodes.name: Entry Setup
nodes.description: Prepares controls, body position and heading before committing to the gybe.

nodes.name: Mainsail Transfer
nodes.description: Controls the mainsail across the boat without slamming or losing control.

nodes.name: Exit Heading
nodes.description: Finishes the gybe on the intended course without over-rotating or rounding up.

nodes.name: Heavy Air Gybes
nodes.description: Completes gybes in strong winds by timing them at maximum boat speed.

nodes.name: Sail Trim Fundamentals
nodes.description: Setting and adjusting sails for flow, power and balance.

nodes.name: Telltale Reading
nodes.description: Interprets telltales and leech ribbons to identify stalled or luffing flow.

nodes.name: Sheet Tension
nodes.description: Sets sheet tension appropriate to wind strength, sea state and point of sail.

nodes.name: Twist Control
nodes.description: Adjusts leech twist to match wind gradient and power requirements.

nodes.name: Power Adjustment
nodes.description: Changes sail depth and power with the available controls as conditions change.

nodes.name: Steering & Balance
nodes.description: Driving the boat with feel, minimal rudder and correct heel.

nodes.name: Helm Feel
nodes.description: Recognises and responds to changes in helm load and weather helm.

nodes.name: Minimal Rudder Use
nodes.description: Steers with small, smooth rudder movements to reduce drag.

nodes.name: Heel Angle Control
nodes.description: Maintains the optimum heel angle for the boat and conditions.

nodes.name: Fore-and-Aft Trim
nodes.description: Positions weight longitudinally to optimise waterline length and wave handling.

nodes.name: Speed Control
nodes.description: Accelerating, slowing and holding position deliberately.

nodes.name: Acceleration
nodes.description: Builds speed quickly from low speed by bearing away and trimming progressively.

nodes.name: Controlled Deceleration
nodes.description: Slows the boat on demand without losing steerage.

nodes.name: Holding Position
nodes.description: Keeps the boat nearly stationary while retaining the ability to manoeuvre.

nodes.name: Low-Speed Manoeuvring
nodes.description: Turns and repositions the boat confidently at very low speed.

nodes.name: Heavy Air Technique
nodes.description: Keeping the boat fast and under control in strong winds.

nodes.name: Depowering
nodes.description: Reduces power early and effectively using sail controls and trim.

nodes.name: Gust Response
nodes.description: Responds to gusts by easing, steering or hiking before the boat heels excessively.

nodes.name: Wipeout Avoidance
nodes.description: Anticipates and prevents broaches, death rolls and capsizes.

nodes.name: Physical Endurance
nodes.description: Sustains hiking, trimming and steering effort for the full race.

nodes.name: Light Air Technique
nodes.description: Maintaining flow and momentum in light and fluky winds.

nodes.name: Smooth Movement
nodes.description: Moves around the boat gently to avoid disturbing sail flow.

nodes.name: Weight Placement
nodes.description: Uses leeward heel and forward weight to reduce wetted area and hold sail shape.

nodes.name: Flow Maintenance
nodes.description: Keeps sails eased and flow attached, avoiding over-trimming.

nodes.name: Patience in Lulls
nodes.description: Holds course and trim through lulls rather than over-steering.

nodes.name: Communication & Coordination
nodes.description: Coordinating actions and sharing information on board.

nodes.name: Call Clarity
nodes.description: Uses concise, consistent calls for manoeuvres and tactical changes.

nodes.name: Role Clarity
nodes.description: Understands and performs individual responsibilities in each phase of the race.

nodes.name: Manoeuvre Synchronisation
nodes.description: Times steering, trimming and weight movement together.

nodes.name: Information Flow
nodes.description: Shares wind, traffic and speed information proactively and accurately.

nodes.name: Starting
nodes.description: Executing starts that deliver speed, clear air and a strategic position at the signal.

nodes.name: Pre-Start Preparation
nodes.description: Gathering information and planning before the warning signal.

nodes.name: Course Reconnaissance
nodes.description: Sails part of the first leg to gather wind and current information.

nodes.name: Wind Baseline
nodes.description: Records compass headings to establish the mean wind direction and shift range.

nodes.name: Line Bias Assessment
nodes.description: Determines the favoured end of the starting line accurately.

nodes.name: Transit Identification
nodes.description: Identifies line transits on shore or beyond the line ends.

nodes.name: Line Judgement
nodes.description: Knowing where the line is while sailing near it.

nodes.name: Distance to Line
nodes.description: Estimates distance to the line in boat lengths during the final approach.

nodes.name: Transit Use
nodes.description: Uses transits to judge line position, especially mid-line.

nodes.name: Line Sag Awareness
nodes.description: Recognises when the fleet is sagging behind the line and exploits it.

nodes.name: OCS Avoidance
nodes.description: Starts consistently close to the line without being on the course side.

nodes.name: Timing
nodes.description: Managing time and distance to reach the line at speed on the signal.

nodes.name: Time-on-Distance Runs
nodes.description: Measures how long it takes to reach the line from known positions.

nodes.name: Countdown Awareness
nodes.description: Maintains accurate awareness of time remaining throughout the sequence.

nodes.name: Final Approach Adjustment
nodes.description: Adjusts speed and course to hit the line at the signal.

nodes.name: Signal Sequence Knowledge
nodes.description: Knows the starting sequence and the meaning of each signal.

nodes.name: Positioning
nodes.description: Securing and defending a spot on the line.

nodes.name: Spot Selection
nodes.description: Chooses a position that suits the plan and the fleet density.

nodes.name: Gap Creation
nodes.description: Creates space to leeward to accelerate into.

nodes.name: Gap Defence
nodes.description: Prevents competitors from taking the leeward gap.

nodes.name: Approach Choice
nodes.description: Selects a port or starboard approach appropriate to the line and fleet.

nodes.name: Acceleration & Launch
nodes.description: Hitting the line at full speed and emerging with clear air.

nodes.name: Trigger Timing
nodes.description: Starts accelerating at the right moment to be at full speed on the signal.

nodes.name: Speed at Signal
nodes.description: Crosses the line at or near target speed.

nodes.name: Height After Launch
nodes.description: Holds height off the line to protect the leeward gap.

nodes.name: First Minute Lane
nodes.description: Keeps a clear lane in the first minute after the start.

nodes.name: Start Strategy
nodes.description: Linking the start to the plan for the first beat.

nodes.name: End Versus Middle Decision
nodes.description: Weighs favoured-end gains against risk and congestion.

nodes.name: Strategic Side Alignment
nodes.description: Starts where it best serves the preferred side of the first beat.

nodes.name: Fleet Density Reading
nodes.description: Reads where the fleet is bunching and adjusts accordingly.

nodes.name: Plan Adaptation
nodes.description: Adjusts the start plan in response to late shifts or crowding.

nodes.name: Starting Rules
nodes.description: Applying the racing rules in the pre-start and at the start.

nodes.name: Pre-Start Right of Way
nodes.description: Applies right-of-way rules correctly while manoeuvring before the start.

nodes.name: Barging Awareness
nodes.description: Understands that barging boats are not entitled to room at a starting mark.

nodes.name: Recall Procedures
nodes.description: Responds correctly to individual and general recalls.

nodes.name: Start Penalty Flags
nodes.description: Knows the consequences of the I, Z, U and black flag rules.

nodes.name: Upwind Performance
nodes.description: Sailing to windward fast and high while making sound tactical and strategic decisions.

nodes.name: Upwind Speed
nodes.description: Achieving and sustaining target speed to windward.

nodes.name: Target Speed
nodes.description: Reaches known target speed for the wind strength.

nodes.name: Speed Consistency
nodes.description: Maintains speed with little variation through gusts and lulls.

nodes.name: Mode Switching
nodes.description: Switches between high and fast modes on demand.

nodes.name: Speed Testing
nodes.description: Compares speed with nearby boats and acts on the results.

nodes.name: Pointing
nodes.description: Sailing at the best angle to the wind for velocity made good.

nodes.name: VMG Optimisation
nodes.description: Balances height and speed to maximise progress to windward.

nodes.name: Groove Steering
nodes.description: Stays in the steering groove without luffing or stalling.

nodes.name: Pinching Avoidance
nodes.description: Recognises and avoids sailing too high and slow.

nodes.name: Footing Judgement
nodes.description: Knows when to sail lower and faster for tactical gain.

nodes.name: Shift Recognition
nodes.description: Identifying and responding to changes in wind direction.

nodes.name: Compass Use
nodes.description: Uses compass headings to detect lifts and headers.

nodes.name: Header Identification
nodes.description: Identifies headers quickly and decides whether to tack.

nodes.name: Shift Pattern Recognition
nodes.description: Distinguishes oscillating, persistent and geographic shift patterns.

nodes.name: Shift Anticipation
nodes.description: Reads incoming shifts from boats ahead, clouds and water patterns.

nodes.name: Pressure Reading
nodes.description: Finding and using stronger wind.

nodes.name: Gust Spotting
nodes.description: Identifies darker patches and ripples indicating pressure on the water.

nodes.name: Gust Timing
nodes.description: Predicts when and where a gust will arrive.

nodes.name: Lull Avoidance
nodes.description: Steers away from light patches and holes.

nodes.name: Pressure Versus Shift Priority
nodes.description: Decides correctly between sailing for pressure or for a shift.

nodes.name: Waves & Sea State
nodes.description: Adapting technique to chop and swell.

nodes.name: Wave Steering
nodes.description: Steers up the face and down the back of waves to minimise slamming.

nodes.name: Chop Power Settings
nodes.description: Adds power and twist to drive through chop.

nodes.name: Flat Water Settings
nodes.description: Uses flatter, higher-pointing settings in smooth water.

nodes.name: Swell Angle Adaptation
nodes.description: Adjusts technique for swell direction relative to the course.

nodes.name: Lane Management
nodes.description: Keeping clear air and freedom to manoeuvre.

nodes.name: Clear Air Awareness
nodes.description: Recognises the wind shadow and disturbed air from other boats.

nodes.name: Escaping Bad Air
nodes.description: Exits disturbed air quickly by tacking or footing.

nodes.name: Lee-Bow Positioning
nodes.description: Positions on an opponent's lee bow to force them away.

nodes.name: Lane Holding
nodes.description: Protects a lane with speed and height.

nodes.name: Laylines
nodes.description: Judging and approaching the layline to the windward mark.

nodes.name: Layline Judgement
nodes.description: Judges the layline accurately, allowing for current and leeway.

nodes.name: Overstanding Avoidance
nodes.description: Avoids sailing past the layline and wasting distance.

nodes.name: Early Layline Avoidance
nodes.description: Avoids committing to the layline too early from a distance.

nodes.name: Layline Traffic
nodes.description: Manages congestion and disturbed air near the layline.

nodes.name: Tactical Tacking
nodes.description: Choosing when and where to tack.

nodes.name: Tacking on Headers
nodes.description: Tacks on significant headers in oscillating winds.

nodes.name: Crossing Decisions
nodes.description: Decides correctly whether to cross, duck or tack on opponents.

nodes.name: Tack Economy
nodes.description: Avoids unnecessary tacks to limit distance loss.

nodes.name: Leverage Management
nodes.description: Controls lateral separation from the fleet relative to risk.

nodes.name: Downwind Performance
nodes.description: Sailing efficiently downwind with good angles, pressure use and tactics.

nodes.name: Downwind Speed
nodes.description: Achieving the best downwind velocity made good.

nodes.name: VMG Angle Selection
nodes.description: Sails the angle that maximises downwind progress for the conditions.

nodes.name: Puff and Lull Steering
nodes.description: Bears away in puffs and heads up in lulls to keep speed.

nodes.name: Apparent Wind Awareness
nodes.description: Understands how boat speed changes the apparent wind angle.

nodes.name: Downwind Speed Consistency
nodes.description: Maintains steady speed through varying pressure.

nodes.name: Wave Riding
nodes.description: Using waves to gain speed downwind.

nodes.name: Wave Catching
nodes.description: Uses steering and permitted body movement to catch waves.

nodes.name: Wave Linking
nodes.description: Connects waves to extend surfing runs.

nodes.name: Weight Movement on Waves
nodes.description: Moves weight fore and aft to promote surfing.

nodes.name: Trough Avoidance
nodes.description: Steers to avoid burying the bow into the back of the wave ahead.

nodes.name: Downwind Pressure
nodes.description: Finding and connecting pressure downwind.

nodes.name: Looking Behind
nodes.description: Regularly checks upwind for incoming pressure.

nodes.name: Gust Connection
nodes.description: Positions to connect from one gust to the next.

nodes.name: Gybing into Pressure
nodes.description: Gybes to stay in or reach stronger wind.

nodes.name: Hole Avoidance
nodes.description: Avoids light areas and wind shadow from boats and land.

nodes.name: Downwind Shifts
nodes.description: Using wind direction changes downwind.

nodes.name: Downwind Shift Detection
nodes.description: Detects shifts downwind using compass and apparent wind.

nodes.name: Gybing on Lifts
nodes.description: Gybes when lifted downwind to sail the gybe pointing closer to the mark.

nodes.name: Oscillation Timing
nodes.description: Times gybes to match oscillating shifts.

nodes.name: Persistent Shift Response
nodes.description: Sails toward a persistent shift early on the run.

nodes.name: Downwind Trim
nodes.description: Trimming and balancing the boat for downwind speed.

nodes.name: Sheet Ease Cycle
nodes.description: Eases sheets to the edge of luffing and re-trims as the wind changes.

nodes.name: Downwind Twist Control
nodes.description: Uses vang or kicker tension to manage leech twist.

nodes.name: Downwind Heel Control
nodes.description: Uses heel to balance the helm and steer with minimal rudder.

nodes.name: Stability in Breeze
nodes.description: Maintains roll stability in strong downwind conditions.

nodes.name: Downwind Tactics
nodes.description: Attacking and defending downwind.

nodes.name: Wind Shadow Attack
nodes.description: Uses wind shadow to slow boats ahead.

nodes.name: Wind Shadow Defence
nodes.description: Avoids being blanketed by boats behind.

nodes.name: Passing Lanes
nodes.description: Identifies and uses passing lanes on the run.

nodes.name: Inside Position Setup
nodes.description: Sets up the inside position for the next mark.

nodes.name: Downwind Decisions
nodes.description: Planning gybes and the approach on the run.

nodes.name: Downwind Laylines
nodes.description: Judges downwind laylines to avoid extra gybes or over-sailing.

nodes.name: Gybe Economy
nodes.description: Avoids unnecessary gybes.

nodes.name: Side Selection Downwind
nodes.description: Chooses the favoured side of the run based on pressure and current.

nodes.name: Fleet Positioning Downwind
nodes.description: Balances strategy against fleet position on the run.

nodes.name: Mark Roundings
nodes.description: Approaching, rounding and exiting marks efficiently and legally.

nodes.name: Windward Mark Approach
nodes.description: Arriving at the windward mark with speed, clear air and options.

nodes.name: Starboard Layline Approach
nodes.description: Approaches on the starboard layline with clear air.

nodes.name: Port Approach Judgement
nodes.description: Judges when a port-tack approach is viable and safe.

nodes.name: Zone Entry
nodes.description: Enters the three-length zone in a favourable position.

nodes.name: Traffic Anticipation
nodes.description: Anticipates congestion and plans the approach accordingly.

nodes.name: Windward Mark Rounding
nodes.description: Turning downwind at the windward mark without losing distance.

nodes.name: Bear-Away Smoothness
nodes.description: Bears away smoothly while easing sails in coordination.

nodes.name: Trim Through Rounding
nodes.description: Adjusts sail controls through the rounding for the new leg.

nodes.name: Windward Exit Angle
nodes.description: Exits the mark on the planned course for the next leg.

nodes.name: Post-Rounding Lane
nodes.description: Secures clear air immediately after rounding.

nodes.name: Leeward Mark Approach
nodes.description: Setting up for an efficient leeward mark rounding.

nodes.name: Overlap Establishment
nodes.description: Establishes an inside overlap before the zone when possible.

nodes.name: Wide Entry Setup
nodes.description: Sets up for a wide entry and a tight exit.

nodes.name: Early Preparation
nodes.description: Completes preparation for the upwind leg before the mark.

nodes.name: Approach Speed Control
nodes.description: Manages speed to arrive with control and options.

nodes.name: Leeward Mark Rounding
nodes.description: Turning upwind at the leeward mark and exiting high and fast.

nodes.name: Tight Exit
nodes.description: Exits close to the mark without giving away height.

nodes.name: Upwind Trim Transition
nodes.description: Trims to upwind settings during the rounding.

nodes.name: Close-Hauled Exit Heading
nodes.description: Reaches a close-hauled heading immediately after the mark.

nodes.name: Pinned Avoidance
nodes.description: Avoids being pinned by boats exiting ahead or to windward.

nodes.name: Gate Selection
nodes.description: Choosing between gate marks.

nodes.name: Favoured Gate Choice
nodes.description: Selects the gate mark that best suits the next leg.

nodes.name: Gate Traffic Assessment
nodes.description: Assesses congestion at each gate mark.

nodes.name: Gate Strategy Link
nodes.description: Links gate choice to the preferred side of the next beat.

nodes.name: Late Gate Change
nodes.description: Changes gate choice late when conditions justify it.

nodes.name: Reach & Offset Marks
nodes.description: Handling offset marks and reaching legs.

nodes.name: Offset Mark Handling
nodes.description: Rounds offset marks without losing position.

nodes.name: Reach Mark Rounding
nodes.description: Executes gybe or bear-away roundings at reach marks.

nodes.name: Reach Leg Positioning
nodes.description: Chooses high or low lanes on reaching legs.

nodes.name: Reach Speed
nodes.description: Maintains speed on reaching legs with balanced trim.

nodes.name: Mark-Room Rules
nodes.description: Applying the rules at marks.

nodes.name: Zone Rule Application
nodes.description: Applies the rules that begin at the three-length zone.

nodes.name: Mark-Room Entitlement
nodes.description: Knows when mark-room is owed and to whom.

nodes.name: Overlap Determination
nodes.description: Determines overlap status correctly at zone entry.

nodes.name: Touching Mark Penalties
nodes.description: Takes the correct penalty after touching a mark.

nodes.name: Racing Strategy
nodes.description: Planning and adapting the race using wind, current, geography, the fleet and the rules.

nodes.name: Weather Strategy
nodes.description: Using weather knowledge to plan the race.

nodes.name: Forecast Interpretation
nodes.description: Interprets forecasts to anticipate wind trends during racing.

nodes.name: Sea Breeze Understanding
nodes.description: Recognises sea breeze development and its effects.

nodes.name: Gradient Wind Patterns
nodes.description: Understands gradient wind behaviour and its shifts.

nodes.name: Cloud Effects
nodes.description: Anticipates wind changes under and around clouds.

nodes.name: Current & Tide
nodes.description: Using water movement to advantage.

nodes.name: Current Reading
nodes.description: Measures current strength and direction on the course.

nodes.name: Current Strategy
nodes.description: Uses favourable current and avoids adverse current.

nodes.name: Current at Marks
nodes.description: Adjusts mark approaches for current set.

nodes.name: Current at the Line
nodes.description: Accounts for current when starting and finishing.

nodes.name: Geographic Effects
nodes.description: Understanding how land shapes the wind.

nodes.name: Shore Effects
nodes.description: Understands wind bends and acceleration near shorelines.

nodes.name: Wind Shadow from Land
nodes.description: Avoids wind shadow from headlands, buildings and trees.

nodes.name: Channelling
nodes.description: Recognises wind channelling through valleys and gaps.

nodes.name: Thermal Influences
nodes.description: Accounts for local thermal effects on wind direction and strength.

nodes.name: Fleet Management
nodes.description: Managing position and risk relative to the fleet.

nodes.name: Fleet Positioning
nodes.description: Maintains a sound position relative to the fleet.

nodes.name: Risk Management
nodes.description: Adjusts risk according to race position and series standing.

nodes.name: Consolidation
nodes.description: Consolidates gains by moving toward the fleet.

nodes.name: Recovery from Behind
nodes.description: Takes calculated risks to gain from a poor position.

nodes.name: Boat-on-Boat Tactics
nodes.description: Controlling and escaping individual opponents.

nodes.name: Tight Cover
nodes.description: Applies a tight cover to control a specific opponent.

nodes.name: Loose Cover
nodes.description: Stays between an opponent and the next mark without engaging.

nodes.name: Breaking Cover
nodes.description: Escapes a cover using tacks, speed or fakes.

nodes.name: Controlling Opponents
nodes.description: Forces opponents into unfavourable positions.

nodes.name: Racing Rules
nodes.description: Knowing and applying the racing rules.

nodes.name: Right-of-Way Rules
nodes.description: Applies port/starboard, windward/leeward and clear ahead/astern rules.

nodes.name: Limitations on Right of Way
nodes.description: Applies the rules on acquiring right of way and changing course.

nodes.name: Penalty Turns
nodes.description: Takes penalties correctly and promptly.

nodes.name: Protest Process
nodes.description: Understands hailing, flagging and protest hearing procedures.

nodes.name: Mental Performance
nodes.description: Preparing for and staying composed while racing.

nodes.name: Pre-Race Routine
nodes.description: Follows a consistent preparation routine before racing.

nodes.name: Focus Under Pressure
nodes.description: Maintains concentration in close racing.

nodes.name: Error Recovery
nodes.description: Recovers quickly from mistakes without compounding them.

nodes.name: Post-Race Debrief
nodes.description: Reviews performance and identifies lessons after racing.

nodes.name: Finishing
nodes.description: Gaining and protecting places at the finish.

nodes.name: Favoured Finish End
nodes.description: Identifies the favoured end of the finish line.

nodes.name: Final Leg Tactics
nodes.description: Protects or gains positions on the final leg.

nodes.name: Finish Line Approach
nodes.description: Approaches the line on the best tack or gybe.

nodes.name: Shooting the Line
nodes.description: Uses momentum to cross the finish line at the optimal moment.
